capabilities: Build mind maps by typing, with Tab for children and Enter for siblings
Switch the same note between map and outline views with one shortcut
Store maps as plain Markdown headings and nested lists with block ids
Convert existing notes and import Markdown lists, .canvas and OPML files
Export maps as .canvas, Markdown, OPML, or an image
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Dropped and pasted content import is explicitly marked beta, and planned features (org chart layout, image insert) have no date. Works entirely offline with no network requests.
motivation: The author built it because a thought arrives faster than you can draw it, so maps should be typed with the keyboard and stay readable as ordinary notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in mind mapping, and drawing nodes with a mouse is slower than typing and locks the content into a non-Markdown format.

relations.evidence: install BRAT, choose Add beta plugin, and enter jonathanmcw/obsidian-ideascape

summary: Keyboard-driven mind map plugin that stores each map as a plain Markdown nested list and toggles the same note between map and outline views.
